metadata.title: NextGen E-Commerce Platform
evaluation_criteria: Detailed line-item cost estimate (Design, Development, Testing, Integration)
Proposed team composition and resource allocations
Estimated project timeline with key milestone dates
Two case studies of similar e-commerce implementations

requirements.description: Support 50,000+ SKUs with faceted search and instant filtering (e.g., Algolia/Elastic)
Multi-currency checkout, supporting Stripe, Apple Pay, PayPal, and Klarna
Customer account management with order history and payment tracking
Real-time inventory tracking across multiple sales channels
Frontend (Next.js/React) decoupled from backend via REST/GraphQL APIs
PCI-DSS Level 1 compliance, GDPR/CCPA data privacy protocols, and SSL/TLS encryption
WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards and core web vitals optimization
Integration with SAP ERP, HubSpot CRM, and Klaviyo marketing automation
